why: The first npm run build stopped at tsc with TS2345 in Cart.tsx. Instead of fixing it, the learner edited package.json so build is just 'vite build' and ran npm run build again: Vite strips types without checking them, so it printed '✓ built in' while the type error is still in Cart.tsx. The step's build type-checks first; the command name is the same but the check was removed, so the app has not built cleanly.
